$comment: 生成物 —— 由 monorepo 的 scripts/sync-showcase-exhibits.mjs 生成，请勿手改。 元数据已投影为英文；lang 字段标记该模板正文实际用的语言（过渡期中文回退）。

templates.title: SaaS Product Landing Page
templates.summary: Conversion-focused single-page site: hero entrance choreography and number counters, capability cards revealed on scroll, three pricing tiers and an FAQ — a marketing starting point you can ship as-is.

templates.title: Analytics Dashboard
templates.summary: The standard tool-page skeleton: a KPI row, real charts (line and donut), and a detail table — light grey canvas, white cards, and a strict no-animation discipline for utility screens.

templates.title: Campaign Landing Page
templates.summary: A limited-time campaign page: warm seasonal palette, number counters, coupon claim, a bestseller list with sell-through progress, and collapsible rules.

templates.title: CRUD Table Page
templates.summary: The most common back-office list shape: page-header actions, a filter card (keyword, category, status), a data table, and pagination.

templates.title: CRM Customer Management
templates.summary: A master-detail business page: a data-driven customer list (loop-rendered) beside a customer profile with fields, a follow-up timeline, and notes.

templates.title: Mobile App Flow
templates.summary: A three-screen mobile skeleton: an onboarding page with entrance choreography, a home screen with goal cards and a course list, a bottom tab bar, and a sticky action bar on the course detail screen.

templates.title: Data Report Document
templates.summary: A long-form report: reading-progress bar, headline metrics, charts (trend and composition), chapter typography, a detail table, and a methodology note.

templates.title: Scroll Narrative Page
templates.summary: A one-shot hero entrance plus banded scrub animation below the fold (rhythm gears: soft, standard, emphasis) — a dark product-narrative page.

templates.title: Kanban Drag and Drop
templates.summary: A three-column data-driven board: drag by the handle to move cards across columns, write back through the three-state onChange, with live per-column counts.

templates.title: EDM Email Template
templates.summary: An email-safe single-column layout at 600px: brand bar, gradient hero, bulleted body, full-width CTA, and a compliant footer — exportable as either an HTML snapshot or an image.

templates.title: Poster / Digital Invitation
templates.summary: An A4 portrait poster composition: inscription, gold display headline, info rows, an agenda, and a QR registration block — exportable as PNG or PDF.

templates.title: Settings Center
templates.summary: The standard settings layout: left-side section navigation (menu) with a profile form, a notification toggle group, and a danger zone holding the transfer-ownership entry.

templates.title: Data Wall (Monitoring)
templates.summary: A dark control-room wall: a route status bar, four KPI tiles with number counters, two charts, and an event stream — number counters are the only motion, keeping the wall restrained.

templates.title: Support Ticket Desk
templates.summary: A queue-to-detail master-detail layout: a data-driven ticket queue (List) beside a ticket detail view with a summary header, fields, description, handling timeline, and actions.

templates.title: Approval Workflow
templates.summary: The approval trio: submission (a steps indicator plus form), a to-do list with inline approve and reject, and an approval history timeline.

templates.title: Design System Showcase
templates.summary: Design tokens on display: color palette, type scale, button and tag variants, form controls, and a spacing scale — a living specimen page for the platform components.

templates.title: Clickable Prototype
templates.summary: A three-screen click-through (sign-in, workspace, project detail) where whole cards are clickable via container onClick plus nav.to — a starting point for flow prototypes.

templates.title: Pitch Deck
templates.summary: A five-slide proposal deck (cover, insight, solution, data, closing) with page numbers and previous/next controls on every slide, alternating light and dark rhythm.

templates.title: Brand Identity Kit
templates.summary: A brand manual: logo rules, a four-color primary and secondary system, three type tiers, application examples (business card, letterhead, packaging), and usage restrictions.

templates.title: Pinned Narrative, Parallax and Layers
templates.summary: Three advanced scroll-narrative techniques: sticky scroll pinning with banded scene changes, dual-rate parallax light spots, and layered cards built in pure CSS.

templates.title: Value Interpolation
templates.summary: A hero that types itself out character by character plus three metric groups counting up — the default text and numbers are the final frame, so the degraded view is already complete.

templates.title: Pointer Effects
templates.summary: A magnetic ticket CTA (one per screen) plus a damped spotlight that follows the cursor, passing pointer events through and sitting beneath the content — inert on touch devices.

templates.title: Interaction Loops
templates.summary: Two event-driven loops: inline editing with a draft state and paired flags, and a delete-confirmation overlay that only submits once the original name is typed, passing the result back across pages.

templates.title: Line Art (Illustration Studio)
templates.summary: Paper-white ground with monochrome ink lines: thin-stroke SVG illustrations (outline only, no fill), airy wide-tracked typography, hairline work frames, and a statement band — the illustration is the content.

templates.title: Experimental Type (Type Foundry)
templates.summary: Type as graphic: three stacked experimental headlines (solid, outlined, knocked out), extreme tracking, typeface specimen cards, a tiled glyph set, and fluorescent yellow-green accents.

templates.title: Claymorphism (Pottery Studio)
templates.summary: Cream ground with candy-colored soft blocks: double-shadow volume (outer drop shadow plus inner highlight), 40px-radius corners, hand-pinched soft-shape illustrations, and rounded course cards.

templates.title: Lamp Illustration (Night Brand)
templates.summary: A midnight blue-purple ground with warm yellow halos: hand-drawn lamps (desk, pendant, floor) each casting a pool of light, an "evening of light" narrative, and a physical space section.

templates.title: Organic Curves (Movement Studio)
templates.summary: Soft misty blue and dusty pink gradients with large continuous flowing curves and blobs: asymmetric rounded layouts, movement-line illustrations, and generous breathing room.

templates.title: Material Design (Task App)
templates.summary: Material Design 3 vocabulary: tonal palette layering from surface to primary-container, large radii and elevation shadows, and a faithful product mock-up with a navigation rail, task list, and FAB.

templates.title: Data Dashboard (NOC Wall)
templates.summary: Near-black blue canvas with fluorescent data colors and monospaced numerals: five KPI tiles with mini trends, a line-chart area, load donuts, and an event-stream table — every chart hand-drawn in SVG, built for shift-room wall displays.

templates.title: Terminal Aesthetic (CLI Landing)
templates.summary: Terminal palette, monospaced type, prompt lines and a cursor: a hero built as a terminal window with the install command and real output, a man-page style flag table, benchmark comparisons, and step-by-step quickstart.

templates.title: Quiet Luxury (Fine Jewellery)
templates.summary: Near-black ground with champagne-gold hairlines and very light weights at wide leading: a centered inscription hero, hairline collection entries, a large hero piece in a thin gold frame with a glass caption, and a three-column private service section.

templates.title: Editorial Fashion
templates.summary: Black, white, and acid red with oversized masthead typography: a full-bleed cover with overlaid title, numbered LOOK entries, a film screening section using the video component with a poster frame, and a subscribe CTA.

templates.title: Narrative Scroll (A Day in the City)
templates.summary: Scroll-driven chaptered storytelling: a reading-progress indicator (motion.progress), three chapters scrubbed with rhythm gears (motion.scroll, fully reversible), and a dusk skyline parallax layer (motion.parallax).

templates.title: Memphis (Creative Agency)
templates.summary: The 1980s Memphis language of saturated clashing colors, heavy black outlines, and wavy dot patterns: sticker-style cards, diagonal color bands, clipped decorations, and playful asymmetric composition.

templates.title: Abstract Geometry (Art Exhibition)
templates.summary: Warm grey paper ground with four large color blocks and oversized overlapping planes: gallery-style typography with catalogue numbers, materials and dimensions, a curator quote band, and a visitor information table.

templates.title: Split Screen (Two-Sided Cafe)
templates.summary: A 50:50 day-and-night split: a glowing seam down the middle, a journey composition where the left column sticks while the right scrolls, mirrored menus, and a CTA that merges at the seam.

templates.title: Low-Poly 3D (Collectible Drop)
templates.summary: Darkroom ground with faceted decorations and two accent colors: the core section uses the model3d component to host a real rotatable 3D model (a glb served from the asset library and seeded automatically on app creation), closing with faceted collectible cards and a process band.

templates.title: Black and White Photography Portfolio
templates.summary: Pure black, white, and grey in three steps with editorial typography: staggered oversized headings, full-bleed work images overlaid with caption cards and vertical series labels, a row-based series index, and a black statement band — asset-driven, with photographs served from the asset library and seeded on app creation.

templates.title: Bauhaus (Geometry Studio)
templates.summary: The Bauhaus language of primary colors, primitive shapes, and heavy typography: a hero with staggered oversized type under layered geometric ornaments, a black manifesto band, staggered work cards, and a red CTA — a typography-driven starting point with strong design presence.

templates.title: Retro Screen Print Poster
templates.summary: A poster reproduction built from one illustrated base image with everything else overprinted in type: extra-heavy outlined headline with a misregistered magenta shadow, rotated circular badges, script accents, a red menu board, and a yellow three-column info strip — one asset plus platform capability equals a finished piece.

templates.title: 3D Portfolio Cover
templates.summary: A portfolio cover stacking two assets, a background and a cut-out figure: an oversized gradient headline tucked beneath the figure, mint badges and skill tags, app-icon tiles, and top and bottom info bars — a full demonstration of multi-asset positioning with transparent art in front.

templates.title: 3D Portfolio Landing Page
templates.summary: The full-page counterpart to the cover, sharing its assets: the hero uses container query units (cqw) to hold its proportions, the work grid auto-fits between three, two, and one columns, and the about section stacks on its own — only two explicit breakpoint decisions in the whole page.
